description: Re-ran the 9 most promising pre-provenance experiments using live or live-representative data and modern extractors. Classified each as CONFIRMED, INCONCLUSIVE, or RULED_OUT.

experiments.title: Global Consistency Checker (live re-test of Exp 172/176)
experiments.notes: Matches Exp 172/176 synthetic baseline exactly. Detection is logic-based (entity value comparison), not inference-mode-dependent. Works on live-representative multi-turn chains.

experiments.title: Tier 1 Self-Learning Retrained on Live-Only Traces (re-test of Exp 134)
experiments.notes: FP reduced 86% (7→1), matching Exp 223. But primary success metric (task success rate) is flat at 32.74% for both strategies. The self-learning architecture reduces false alarms but does not improve task success rate on held-out cases.

experiments.title: Agent Rollback Verification (re-test of Exp 126-127)
experiments.notes: 100% rollback success and violation detection. Caveat: tested with canned outputs (live_mode=false), not live GPU inference. The rollback logic is deterministic and does not depend on inference mode — result should generalize.

experiments.title: FactualKBExtractor on Gemma4-E4B-it (re-test of Exp 158)
experiments.notes: Both coverage (45% ≥ 40%) and accuracy (100% ≥ 75%) targets met. Coverage dropped 51pp from Exp 158 (96%) because IT model responses have less free-form factual text. Accuracy improved 17pp. Tested with representative (not live GPU) responses.

experiments.title: Adaptive KAN Verification on Live Traces (re-test of Exp 175)
experiments.notes: KAN architecture achieves AUROC=0.991 on live Exp 219-221 traces — confirmed high-performance on real data. Adaptive mesh refinement (AMR) pruned 17 params but produced no AUROC improvement. AMR benefit not demonstrated; base KAN confirmed.

experiments.title: Full GSM8K with Z3+LLM+Semantic Extractors (re-test of Exp 91-92)
experiments.notes: Z3 and LLM each achieve 80% detection, 0% FP. Semantic grounding detects 0% of arithmetic GSM8K errors and adds 20% FP — it is designed for different failure modes (quantity mismatch, not pure arithmetic). Combined adds no unique detections but raises FP to 20%.

experiments.title: Combined Verification Signals with Modern Extractors (re-test of Exp 142)
experiments.notes: Conductor log records OK status and 3068 tests passed, but results/experiment_277_results.json is absent. Test suite confirms code runs but no quantitative artifact is available to classify the approach. Needs a re-run with explicit JSON output.

experiments.title: Cross-Session Constraint Memory (re-test of Exp 136)
experiments.notes: Session boundary save/load preserves all 94 entries. Warm retrieval hit rate 100% across all three benchmark types. 0% FP on unseen slice. Confirmed: cross-session constraint memory persists correctly and retrieves with high precision.

experiments.title: Adversarial Number-Swapped GSM8K with Semantic Grounding (re-test of Exp 178)
experiments.notes: Semantic grounding detects 100% of stale errors (responses using original numbers against swapped question). Blind to fresh-wrong errors (quantity-consistent wrong answers). FP rate 20%, but +40pp lift over random. Confirms semantic grounding's specific strength: quantity-mismatch detection.

key_findings: GlobalConsistencyChecker (Exp 271): detection=100%, FP=0% on live-representative chains — architecture confirmed at 1.91ms/call
Z3+LLM extractors (Exp 276): 80% detection, 0% FP on GSM8K arithmetic — semantic grounding ruled out for arithmetic-only tasks
Cross-session memory (Exp 278): 100% warm hit rate, 0% FP unseen, session boundary verified
Adversarial semantic grounding (Exp 279): 100% stale detection, +40pp lift — quantity-mismatch is the detectable mode
KAN AUROC=0.991 (Exp 275): architecture confirmed on live traces; AMR showed no benefit
Self-learning FP reduction (Exp 272): 86% FP reduction confirmed but task-success-rate gain not demonstrated
Exp 277 results JSON missing — needs re-run for quantitative classification
